summary: Closed the store-failure account's open inference about elections by reading both sides of the vote path: the grant decision compares the candidate's log against the last index and term held in state, and a node that campaigns builds its RequestVote from those same two fields, so a node whose store lost a suffix it still claims offers and defends an entry the store no longer holds. Added two source anchors (raft.go 1730-1744 and 2008-2016), a behavior knowledge entry for that in-memory source of the election log with its conditions, and narrowed the question's discriminator to the live leader's retry walk plus this vote consequence. Validation returned valid with those effects and no execution requested; remaining incomplete work is the measurement of both, since the vote consequence is still source-read and no live leader has been observed walking nextIndex down to the whole-log request.
